I want to share a little of my story with you - but first, I have to ask...
#### **[Will you chip in $5 or $10 to my grassroots campaign today? The LAST public fundraising deadline before my primary is tomorrow, and we still need another 4,071 contributions to hit our goal!](https://substack.com/redirect/7d1b4b1c-2a43-4e67-abbc-d0102bc82783?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/7d1b4b1c-2a43-4e67-abbc-d0102bc82783?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Alright, back to my story...
I grew up on Andrews Air Force Base. My dad served, and our family believed in duty, honor, and community. Not as words on a wall, but as a code you actually live by.
I went on to play offensive lineman in college. On the line, your job isn't to be the star player -- it's to protect the people around you. Block. Hold the line. Make sure nobody gets through.
**I didn 't know it then, but I was training for everything that came next.**
I was working as a Capitol Police Officer on January 6th, 2021, when a violent mob stormed the building to overturn an election and destroy our democracy.
I was terrified, but I didn't run. I stood my ground. I defended this country, because that's what you do when it's your turn to answer the call. You don't think about it. You don't weigh the odds. You just do your job.
That's me. I'm not a career politician, and I'm not a millionaire. I'm a dad, a kid from a military family, a public servant, and a Marylander who thinks we deserve better.
Now I'm running for Congress - _and the other side is terrified._
Shady outside groups are pouring nearly **$5 MILLION** into this race to stop me. They're desperate to keep a regular guy like me out of the halls of Congress.
#### **[So please, help me fight back, win this race, and flip the House blue by chipping in $5 or $10 before tomorrow's deadline:](https://substack.com/redirect/7d1b4b1c-2a43-4e67-abbc-d0102bc82783?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Together in the fight,
Harry Dunn

name: Voter Action Project
subject: Flat out lies
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Opponents of voting rights lack the common sense to understand that these anti-voting conspiracy theories are just flat-out lies. They'd rather see a vast web of shadowy interests arrayed against them than reexamine their own values when they lose elections.
That's why they create bills like the SAVE America, SAVE, and MEGA Acts, to strip our fundamental right to vote until only their select few have the privilege to vote.
Step up with $35 or more right now to stop the SAVE Act and defend our right to vote from these vicious attacks >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=060226_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NYT: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims of Voter Fraud [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=060226_3&amount=25]
President Trump used his recent State of the Union address and the DHS funding debate to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address his often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. There are stats from the conservative, right-wing Heritage Foundation below that prove it.
The SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=060226_3&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE AMERICA Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=060226_3&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=060226_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=060226_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=060226_3&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=060226_3&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=060226_3&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=060226_3&amount=35]
How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
Reuters has a fuller accounting in recent reporting. Florida, for example, spent millions investigating voter fraud and creating a new state department to oversee election security. They've only prosecuted two non-citizens for voting since 2022. North Carolina said they found nine non-citizens registered to vote out of 7.7 million voters. Utah recently investigated their entire voter roll of 2.1 million registered voters and found one registered non-citizen who never attempted to vote.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. "
Team, the lies aren't going to stop, but we can push back and make sure bills like this abomination never pass. Pitch in $35 or however much you can to stand against voter suppression bills in Congress and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=060226_3&amount=35]

It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

name: Josh Turek
subject: I’m Josh Turek and I’m the nominee to replace Joni Ernst in Iowa.
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_4.OXtgld&refcode=em20260602-4&t=1001&akid=6980%2E582294%2EAoWIkZ ]Josh Turek

I’m Josh Turek. I’m a Democratic state legislator who won a deep red seat,
four-time Paralympian, and two-time gold medalist in wheelchair
basketball.

I thought the feeling of winning my first gold medal at the 2016 Rio
Paralympics would only come once in a lifetime. But, the race was just
called:

I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Iowa’s open U.S. Senate seat.

Grassroots
energy usually peaks in the first few days after a primary, so we have to
get down to business ASAP. [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_4.OXtgld&refcode=em20260602-4&t=1002&akid=6980%2E582294%2EAoWIkZ ]Will you help me make the most of our
hard-fought victory by splitting a donation between my campaign and Chris
Pappas to become one of the first Founding Donors of my General Election
campaign?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_4.OXtgld&amount=5&refcode=em20260602-4&t=1003&akid=6980%2E582294%2EAoWIkZ ]Split a donation »

I’m honored that the people of Iowa have put their faith in me, and I’m
ready to take this once-in-a-generation shot to win this OPEN seat and be
the champion working people deserve in Washington.

I got into this race because like millions of fellow Democrats, I was fed
up with losing, fed up with treating “red” states like lost causes and
tired of perpetually playing defense.

I won this primary because I played offense, and I’m going to run a
relentless full-court press to win this seat in November.

I don’t take a penny of corporate PAC money. Your support, and your
support alone, will help us flip Iowa blue for the first time in more than
a decade and take back the Senate Majority.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_4.OXtgld&refcode=em20260602-4&t=1004&akid=6980%2E582294%2EAoWIkZ ]I’m personally asking you to become one of our first General Election
Founding Donors by splitting a contribution of $15, $20, $35, or more
today. Your contribution will power my voter outreach so I can flip Joni
Ernst’s Senate seat and restore hope and faith in the great state of Iowa.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_4.OXtgld&amount=5&refcode=em20260602-4&t=1005&akid=6980%2E582294%2EAoWIkZ ]Split a donation »

Look, I’m
under no illusions about the work it’ll take to win a battleground Senate
race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst, Ashley Hinson, and their
billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast of a challenge —
physically, mentally, financially.

But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back
victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one
point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson.

This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now.

We have 153 days to bring independents and conservatives into our Prairie
Populist coalition; to overcome over $40 million in spending from MAGA
megadonors; and to let the world know that working-class Americans own the
future.

Ads, statewide tours, and campaign infrastructure don’t come cheap, and
our campaign coffers are nearly empty after a hard-fought and high-cost
primary victory.

The outcome of this race will decide the Senate majority with huge
implications for our country, so my team and I need every single solitary
ounce of support to hit the ground rolling. [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_4.OXtgld&refcode=em20260602-4&t=1006&akid=6980%2E582294%2EAoWIkZ ]Will you rush a split
contribution to become one of my first General Election Founding Donors in
this high-stakes Senate race ASAP?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260602_4.OXtgld&amount=5&refcode=em20260602-4&t=1025&akid=6980%2E582294%2EAoWIkZ ]Donate $5 »

We have a ton of work to do and history to make here in Iowa.

Let's do this.

Talk soon,

Josh Turek

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=6980%2E582294%2EAoWIkZ

body:
Are you ready, New Mexico?!

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=10079%2E400544%2ETnksLz)

[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk809-fr-nd&t=2&akid=10079%2E400544%2ETnksLz)
**I am officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico!**
| | [Chip in to keep this incredible momentum going](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk809-fr-nd&t=3&akid=10079%2E400544%2ETnksLz)

This is a huge milestone, friend — and it's one I couldn't have reached without you. **_Thank you._**

I’m a daughter of Pueblo women, a New Mexican, a single mother, and a former small business owner. I’ve served as a Congresswoman and became the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. **_[And when we win this race in November, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk809-fr-nd&t=4&akid=10079%2E400544%2ETnksLz)_**
Thanks to supporters like you, we're now one step closer to delivering for working families and making our vision of a New Mexico for New Mexicans a reality.
But there’s still a long road to November, and Republicans are already watching to see whether we can keep this momentum going – ready to spend anything to bring their extremist agenda here.
Our campaign has always been about New Mexicans building something together. I am ready to deliver stronger schools, affordable childcare and housing, higher wages, support for small businesses, better healthcare access, and safer communities. The general election is about more than what we stand to lose. It’s about what we stand to gain.
So, are you ready New Mexico?

Are you ready to fight for lower costs?

Are you ready to fight for healthcare?

Are you ready to fight for safe communities?

Are you ready to fight for education?

Are you ready to show Donald Trump and his administration that, here in New Mexico, we believe in dignity and respect?
I’m ready to lead New Mexico forward. I’ve lived the challenges working families are facing and taken on tough fights to deliver real results. I know what it takes to win in November — but I can’t do it alone: **_[So please, will you chip in to help me hit our first $50,000 general election goal, win this November, and keep New Mexico blue?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk809-fr-nd&t=5&akid=10079%2E400544%2ETnksLz)_**

Peter,

**California Polls have closed. Votes are being counted._Before the results come in, I want to take a moment to thank you._**

Thank you for believing in this campaign, for volunteering, talking to friends and neighbors, contributing what you could, and making your voice heard.

We'll have more to share as results come in tonight. But for now, please know how grateful I am for your support and for everything you've done to make this campaign possible.

Scott Wiener

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1888, the baseball poem _[Casey at the Bat](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFurDAQheGngQ5kj30NFC5uQ7dpU1oGj5dJbIzw7K54-2jzCumPPun8nzd385Rov3_4jJZjcTu-akJmPB2fj3x8U0pVjgulRGWPjz347ECA6YTphHLBU7qcboONiICqRSuHUehRKq3bzWoMkwywRABhJiVDjALiGE2EKfzzpiX71oQRSgoxCd0vox9wGCSuyuME2GiBgbic_VehnTeM6SpPPPu15DbZjfmojfrfwNzATHssfb4q01rZ5-M9amBefcWr89zxht3i2XGgrYG5PW04Xu9v1QyNFvfsKf3C_KcaTws_AQAA__9O0nQg),_ penned by Ernest Lawrence Thayer, was first published in the San Francisco _ Daily Examiner_, with its famous final line (spoiler alert!): _" But there is no joy in Mudville--mighty Casey has struck out."_ A little fish in Texas and Mexico has thrived for 100,000 years without a single male in sight, cloning itself generation after generation. Scientists thought the all-female Amazon molly should have died out ages ago, but she's still [swimming along just fine](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8GMqO24cAEDi4hm0svRAa3B9-18chuBrFfv2K1f7AVlVRSVen9fcwPGyjszz82omGf5h3PQsiMeeZ8xNf_QFSkXgJRSLs_dmfjrED1AnoB7exsoGvuamc8osK2RiMHDZ2WbdfVm1kXcN5rv2ocpVNK6xHw1-ix7z3Ytq-Dudugh1YCjNA1i7YDDoPEtbU4Kqw6QBc45eZfCjtv6OlKb8zNmmJNZmN-lar9XampUtN5ns2yrHdWqckffGSs1GQzh5Vu9z0mhY32I-0iJqJL8IbCh7IJ3iwXQeGNTviUhYRb4kKbizgDb-lgES1hqbNxr_PGUvqh6uAZbaCvT_wjkG-jPgMAAP__sq6HtA), as we explain in today's _Science_ section. ## Trump Kills $1.8 Billion 'Lawfare' Fund
President Trump's administration is scrapping its roughly [$1.8 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtu4zAQRb-G6mSMSOpVsNhGnbfdUhhJQ2s2fAgkbcP5-kBOlTr1Ae7FOf-u8xXZcbj9RU-m2DgHemZHpVCaS7r744Ody82wsHMcg72HDf0sQXY1dDWoeUN2r1lXm7FEklRFpukH0EOjtK52Y2FYWySrurGB1Q7SqlbhIge76GVpqGJzrkEHqgEYQV-WAXvq-4ZWhTRKEhpo4xLT5X_kUHay7hUflC5r9JUzeylHFuqPkJOQU9lpZ-dOJuS0R0-nkJATbp4D55KwcAxCTu0Iuh11_basf-I6rwmPXGMoXD8Jjxj485ucBYScqmS243lGyV0vNNw88vu1Kr_K-DDyKwAA__8LA4ln) "anti-weaponization" fund, which would have paid people who say they were wrongly targeted by the Justice Department, acting Attorney General Todd Blanche told Congress Tuesday. The money came from [settling Trump's lawsuit](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uhDAQBeDTmM7If4uhcJGGbtOmRAOMl9kYG4FZtDl95Fwh3Ugjvafvfd2HO1Cg-PiEFV32aYh4HQFzxn3I-7lu3xTCIduRQqAU_RlnWAclVMNFw4UeZqDwHkw1O4-oUFfopG2FaaU2plrcaKRHb2GCRmvlR_DWttB03e02eWmhIlfSRCO0FKITph5bsGitxEkDdgqZEThTTnv9TBTzgj680wv3ekprFdyS83Yw_cFUz1R_XVc9jUdRlD9TfTmZ6scAcVqQz-nJIWbiF8KWIv1AphR5gfElnQcy1Ve7m7eriI_GMiMeK1D4q8v_2ujl1G8AAAD__zYZfMw) against the IRS over the leak of his tax returns. "_We are not moving forward with the fund, period,"_ Blanche said. The plan had drawn criticism from both parties, and [Senate Republicans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOozAQBuCnMZ3RYBsMhYtr6HLtlWjAQzK3xkbGCco-_Yq8wnYjjfT_-v5_t-mGHDje_-JGrqxpinQegUqhPJX83PYvDuFo-plD4BTXZ_S4TQpUJ6GToCePHN6TqbxbiRTpilxjezB9o42pHk5bXIA6GAbb6q5dWlxxWZWfbavBQF-xu9KgA90ADGDquUdL1ja0aKRBkTBAnkvK9f_EsTxoDe_0olwvaauCe5SyH0L_EWoUajzPs17m41Jcf6HG6xRq_GAkxsLyJNxT5G8snKK8SNLntO_kZab9OQdeMMpMrxSKUGOVnd_Py390Vhi4b8jhU15-tdjLqZ8AAAD__8dSgec) refused to pass the president's immigration funding bill until it was resolved. Two federal judges had also stepped in, with one [temporarily blocking](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2upDAQhE8DmZGx_fgJHGxC9jbdEDV2M_SssZHdDJo9_Yq5wkurpFJ935_v-RsoUHz8hh0tr2mOeJWAzJhnzud-_KUQSjssFAKluJ7Rwz4rqTohOyH17IHCeza1tyuiQl2jbftBmqHVxtSb1WZZ2xHcANosX-NgFjXiYvxqWvC-g5rsvSY7qVspR2maZYAe-75FpwFHhZWR6IlTbp6JIm-4hnd6YW5c2utgN-ajVPpXpaZKTdd1NXFxN8XdV2o6UiAmVyo1Pc_C5FB4PCDzjpE_oX-g2CBwER9iAZFJXAhHivQPmFIUN7d4QhSdOHIq6E5OWawUsIhyEovsImjTf-mxztYf162rdH1l5GMHCp-v_CPBL6v-BwAA__81DJOA) the fund and another reopening the IRS case to examine whether the settlement was collusive. Critics had warned it could pay people charged over the Jan. 6 protest.
## California Awaits Results from Tuesday's Vote
California held its primary Tuesday, but the [tight governor's race](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1ygzAMgJ_GbHDCJhgGD13Y0rUj52A5USpszjbJ5e179OcJumnQJ333fZznsyWmcH23K5ri4xzwmRlLwTSXtK_bJzHndrgQM8Xg9-DsOkuQfQ19DWp2lvg1d5UzHlGiqtC0eoBuaFXXVTczupOCVp9A6ZMeVO88aClbPzqPSsNSkTmuQQ-qBRihay6D1ah1i4uyOEoUHaCjElNzjxTKDT2_4gNTs8S1YnMrZctCvQk5CTktlld72OcmpquQ0xaZCi1ZyAkZl0IxHPPxU8gJ-h-GfEyBbL0lWm161X-rdcK8c8n1fQ9Y_0JVMm57HkFyr0UH19USf9uUfyV8GPkVAAD__3zuhJA) could take days or even weeks to call. Mail ballots postmarked by Election Day are counted through June 9. Democrats Xavier Becerra, a former federal health secretary, and billionaire Tom Steyer are battling Republican Steve Hilton for the two spots that advance to the [general election](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb_GdEaDbWEoXKSh27Qp0QBjdhJjI9u7aP8-4hXvB143misd3Xv-POYHcuC4_8aDXPVpjnSVQLVSnmt-Hec_DqF0w8IhcIr-FTc8ZgWql9BL0POGHD6zaTbniRTphlxnBzBDp41pnm6wYEkrtaleg9KLGf0wdj1pD2C9pobdTYMedAcwgmmXAS1Z29GqkUZFwgBtXFNu_yaO9Uk-fNKbcrumownuWetZhP4l1CTUdF1Xuy7lXnHnQk33KdR0Zj4wMxW5YmCfcmSU-82JKReZcSUZUpEYdwpU5IGf7z-nC4Wamuy287pFlN4KA_uBHL5a1B-pezv1PwAA__-5gIRl). More than 60 candidates ran to replace term-limited Gov. Gavin Newsom. No Republican has won a statewide race in California since 2006. In another big race, Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass faced [a surprisingly strong challenge](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkE1ugzAQhU9jdkTjsQtm4UWliq6SbZdogCFxO-DIdhJx-4peodv3pPfzfZ2HMwUJ2_VCK_uyxGHjVxYuhdNQ0mO9_wSRrN0YRELclsc20zogYFNDU4MZZgqyD7aa_cKMbCr2unVgnTbWVjc_Mlty-m2axmWEyeoOEFokBw6p464K_kiDBowG6MCeRkctt63myRB3yMoCz6HEdPqOYSs3XmSPT06nKa6V-Fsp96zMu8JeYU_jdDw4PIX95_mQL_zKCnuJuabtysK5XmmPiaRm4amEuNXHBoV9LjHtyvRhVuZDG2MdOtNVyc_310EgN62ycF0pyF99-Rezp8ffAAAA___oLH4n) from GOP candidate Spencer Pratt. Voters in five other states also picked nominees Tuesday, including Iowa, where Democrats chose Josh Turek [to face Rep. Ashley Hinson](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOrCAYhZ8GOwwgohYUt7Gb225pfvV3YAbBAA5xn37jvsJ2JznJl3O-r8f0AOusf_6HHXXewuSxJIc5Y5xyPPfjbZ1LvJ-tczb47fQr7JNgQlGmKGumFay7JlmtekMU2FSoedcz2fNGysrolS0geNt2apn7XrQtCJBs42rgQs3tVll905hiDWdsYLKee-iw6zguDeAgkEiGq80h1q9gfTa4uSt8MNZL2CunTc5HIs0_IkYixlJKvczpfnH3RIx3JGK0oQBN6CEjPaLdIV40YjpdThSScXhRY30Knr5CMjSfEd_0GxZDCxh3E6qo16PcHpLqiGTPHaz7HZH_ZO6jxU8AAAD__5YZhGs), the winner of the Republican primary for the state's open U.S. Senate seat.
## Remote Work, Not AI, Hitting Young Grads
The rise of remote work, not artificial intelligence, explains most of the recent jump in joblessness among young college graduates, according to a [new analysis](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAUhJ8Gd1hwQJgUFNu4y7ZbWtgcEhJ-LCCx_PYr31e49Ugz833_7svdhhjy469NaLovS8ajRewd69LrJ-3vEGPjeg0xhpL9JzubFmCgKFOUicXZEM9FDs54REAxoOGTZlJzIeXwNP62gmNKgJPWWtwU56C40Ay817jqIZirjSkmOGM3JsdV2wmnieMmLN4AiWToQi91fJWQ-xN9PMsX67iVNETz7H1vRPwhMBOYj-MY9zPl3q6YwIxbySWdBOZrhsCcT-rRUR-ya7RiKh3pUeqb5tKpDfQCRkcx93rSiF-M9FXWRmAeqnH7cYloaiKSPZIN8edF_5W6r4H_AQAA__-vdoOD) from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Employers say they're filling work-from-home jobs with [experienced hires](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuOwyAYhE-DOyxeMU5BsY27bLulheEnZsPDwjjIt185V9hmmk_6RjM_j_mhffDp-a0jqOrynKDtAWqFMtdyxO3lQ9jpuPgQfE7uSFbHmRE2YDJgwmerfThn0VnlABjwDhSVIxEj5UJ0qzLcWssHI8DCQC23VEp9E-ZO3M1RzjqvLhsZCKeE3Inol1FLkJKC4RruDJAgYH3Npf_NPtUVXDjzG0pvcuyCWmvddsS_EJsQm1prvUmLuSBi06VGbCKfoIhNBWKugFsuL3zmo674SBC3kM8IqeIEDZ8Xc2D7tcbQFWW3do3fB4kEeUbtw6e5_uuut2J_AQAA__8ogH6U) rather than fresh grads because of the difficulty of training someone over long distance. Unemployment among graduates under 29 rose from 3.1% before the pandemic to 3.7%, even as the rate for older, seasoned workers [slipped](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtuwzAMRb9G3mxQj_oxaOiiLVnaougkKBaVqNHDsOUY-ftC-YUuXIhD3nu-T_pkfPDpejYRZXFZJzy2gKXgqsu6x-XuQ9joePEh-JzcnqyJmgHrW-hb4NoaH55aNFY6RIa8QUmHEcRIuRDNTfLJWNq_iQsOhjsHkxOTG2cqxnmaBxgbL-s16IFTgAlEdxnNgMNAceYGJ4ZEAFpf8tr9Zp_KDV145geu3ZxjE-StlGUj_J0wRZg6jqPbF193hKnPvOgzHhth6uuDMFU_EabgNShh6vzTKrTtijEXbINPd7TtnjAuIT8jplIhQWsjLibWV7BZpV2O6mPrByLgGo0PrzDlXwYfkv0FAAD__4-9gKs). The findings push back on a popular theory that AI is wiping out entry-level roles, though the authors caution that this could change as the technology spreads.

## Court Clears Texas App Age Law
Texas' law requiring age verification on app stores is now in effect after [the Fifth Circuit's ruling](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAURb8GM7oAFeyAYBOz2XRDC_GhrxrFgjfS8_db7S9MfOreOvf--5q-HEY81r9uB0vvkKYDaolABHkq53cuV3kd6F-F4O3KnNJOqU5KKM2F5qKdFofxZ-qaxc5iecoGrDSD6IauF6bZrNeDlP0Ag9RKPo1ZQGsVnvOsuwGM7xu0nzKhRSulkF3_MN0AQppW6dmLRRvWCViQUn7QBrdFiD_pgvzwaW-i3YjOwto_TI1MjbXWx-vtjg9kavysYWq8Y0yNAQNt3GP230g8AhV-I-7Ok7sV-AUZA3pHmA4eXeVr4nhQ4hACeOIhZX6kytTYZLucFWPEcjuuu8N4K9Hvjrys-h8AAP__yEOKAA) stayed an injunction that had blocked it since December. [Senate Bill 2420](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGurCAQBuCn0Y4NIqJbUNzGbm97SwPMrJJFxgCuu29_ozlvcLrJZObPl__fY3oYH3yc_5oVdfk8aYp45IClYJrytqf8zq_o3SsX_JhsidZCxyS4UIwrxtsJjA_fSdagLYd7U6Nu-oHLQXa8rxftQFlhLXTg8K64BYumlyD7QXSNsl3t9RnGFW-bhjeyu_VyQN70rVDWcVB9JTmCL5RuZcFL8QxfemO6OVrroJdStly1fyoxVmI8-TKbaGKh6Om8-dlWYgzkTKjEeKUwM7PDx8zMtqEJmTnaU2FpP_tg-7ZQgHMyMzK3oHtl9qTEVh8pXU8M6IiBDOQ6adgOH4LPl3dejQ8Xr_yu1LcW_wMAAP__d2OQ1g), signed by Gov. Greg Abbott in May 2025, requires Apple, Google, and other app store operators to verify the ages of all users. Minors need parental consent before downloading any app or making in-app purchases. Attorney General Ken Paxton had appealed the December injunction, and the Fifth Circuit's stay is [temporary pending an appeal](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGStCAQhJ9GMyxABf-A4E_M9tILLZTBpRYdC-Zk9-2v9BUununur_v7MT1siGFfv-wGht4epx1KjkAEacrHT8pnfu1heWWCt80z4kZYJsmlYlwx3k7OhviZutqZmbt_ogYj9MC7oeu5rp9GqF4LLrrB9UpJcG03WJDW6XYZhJ19HcxlxhVvxfXXN7obgAvdSjUv3ClddRxcIEwNPeGm8PGDJ6Rmwa2O5kl05Kr9X8mxkmMppXml9byOlRyvNpUcbxmzx8HsCuyEFHxYLAXcWbSF2RixgGOEbEUWdkIG3sNCzGNiO5Y6GXeUEGPIN9C62RDvfPrbaqeRvwEAAP__NBKDyQ). Tech industry groups are challenging the law's constitutionality under the First Amendment.
